```{r}
set.seed(7)
nsims.global <- 10000
```

# Trial data
```{r observed-data}
p0 <- 21/134
p1 <- 42/143
# Round these to match DR's SS effect size of 0.14:
p0 <- 0.16
p1 <- 0.30
```

Simulation study examines RDs of $\delta=\{0.10, 0.14, 0.18\}$. Generate the data by

 - fixing $\theta_0=0.16$ and varying $\theta_1$, i.e. $\theta_1=\{0.26, 0.30, 0.34\}$.
 - varying $\theta_0$ and $\theta_1$ around their observed values:  $\{\theta_0, \theta_1\} = \{0.18, 0.28\}$ and $\{\theta_0, \theta_1\} = \{0.14, 0.32\}$.

```{r}
theta0.vec <- c(0.16, 0.16, 0.16, 0.18, 0.14)
theta1.vec <- c(0.26, 0.30, 0.34, 0.28, 0.32)
iw.results <- vector("list", length(theta1.vec))
mc.error <- numeric(length(theta1.vec))

for(i in 1:length(theta1.vec)){
  one.result <- pwb2stage(N=400, theta0=theta0.vec[i], theta1=theta1.vec[i], nsims=nsims.global)
  iw.results[[i]] <- one.result$ests
  mc.error[i] <- one.result$mc.error.bias
}
iw.results <- do.call(rbind, iw.results)
```


```{r}
iw.results.tab <- iw.results
iw.results.tab$Bias.in.RD <- round(iw.results.tab$Bias.in.RD, 4)
iw.results.tab$bias.100 <- round(iw.results.tab$bias.100, 2)
iw.results.tab$mc.error.bias <- round(iw.results.tab$mc.error.bias, 4) 
names(iw.results.tab) <- c("type", "ntrials", "theta0", "theta1", "theta", "Bias", 
"Bias*100", "MCSE.bias")
tab <- autofit(flextable(iw.results.tab))
tab <- hline(tab, i=c(4, 8, 12, 16))
tab <- bg(tab, i=c(3:4, 7:8, 11:12, 15:16, 19:20), j=c(1,7), bg="grey90")
tab
save_as_html(tab, path=here("vignettes", "figures","2-stage-RD.html"))
```

```{r 2-stage-RD, fig.dim=c(7,5)}
iw.results$sim <- factor(rep(LETTERS[1:length(theta0.vec)], each=4))
iw.results.sub <- iw.results[iw.results$type %in% c("All (unweighted)", "All (precision-weighted)"), ]
iw.plot <- ggplot(data=iw.results.sub, mapping=aes(x=sim, y=bias.100, fill=type))+
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat="identity")+
  labs(x="Scenario",
       y="100*Bias (estimate - true RD)",
       title="Bias in two-arm two-stage design")+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=0), col="grey", linetype="dashed")+
  ylim(max(abs(iw.results.sub$bias.100)) * c(-1.1, 1.1) )+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c(expression(paste(theta[0], "=0.16, ", theta[1], "=0.26")),
                            expression(paste(theta[0], "=0.16, ", theta[1], "=0.30")),
                            expression(paste(theta[0], "=0.16, ", theta[1], "=0.34")),
                            expression(paste(theta[0], "=0.18, ", theta[1], "=0.28")),
                            expression(paste(theta[0], "=0.14, ", theta[1], "=0.32"))
                            ))+
 theme(legend.position="bottom")
iw.plot
#ggsave(file.path("vignettes", "figures","2-stage-RD.png"), plot = iw.plot, device = "png", width=7, height = 5)
```
